name: Metamagic Item Application (Item Mastery, Metamagic)
body:
You can apply the effects of metamagic feats to some magic items.

Prerequisite(s): Use Magic Device 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): Select one metamagic feat with a level increase no higher than +1. Once per day, you can apply the effects of this metamagic feat to a spell you are casting with a spell completion or spell trigger item. This feat does not grant you the metamagic feat you are selecting, only its effects for the purpose above.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Each time you must select a different metamagic feat or gain an additional use of Metamagic Item Application per day.
